summary: Direct Digital Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce the date of its 2026 annual meeting (July 31, 2026) and new deadlines for stockholder proposals and director nominations under Rule 14a-8 and the universal proxy rules. The filing sets a June 22, 2026 deadline for submissions due to the meeting being more than 30 days after the prior year’s meeting. No transaction, activist campaign, or special situation is disclosed. This is a routine procedural notice about meeting logistics and proxy deadlines, not a special situation event. It establishes the governance timeline but does not involve any change of control or strategic review.
